results.title: TC-GEO-1117-001 - All suspect articles verified no cap

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with a large number of suspect articles across multiple sources
When the Actions Center is opened and the Target Sources list renders
Then ev-intelligence.com card shows 8 failing articles - all 8 verified, no cap applied

results.notes: ev-intelligence.com panel shows 8 failing articles, all with verdict Describes Tesla negatively on this page. All 8 passages visible with brand highlighted via mark tag. No cap or truncation observed.

results.title: TC-GEO-1117-002 - Check determines brand family presence and depiction
results.error: SKIPPED - Precondition not available: all 12 sources show only FAILING ARTICLES tab. A source with both Failing and Positive articles tabs is required. Re-enable on a dashboard where at least one source has mixed positive/negative article verdicts.

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with a source that has both a failing article (brand absent) and a positive article
When the source panel is opened
Then both tabs (Failing articles + Positive articles) are visible and switchable

results.notes: Checked all 12 sources. Every source shows only FAILING ARTICLES tab. Brand-absent text confirmed via aol.com (IMPROVE VISIBILITY: No mention of Tesla anywhere on this page).

results.title: TC-GEO-1117-003 - Product named on page counts as brand family

steps.title: Given a completed analysis where a suspect article page names only a brand product (not the parent brand name)
When the explanation panel is opened for that source
Then the article is not classified as brand-absent - it has a depiction verdict

results.notes: PARTIAL - All 8 passages in ev-intelligence.com explicitly mention tesla by brand name. No product-only article found. Cannot verify product-name to brand-family inference from UI alone.

results.title: TC-GEO-1117-004 - False positives not counted as failing
results.error: SKIPPED - Precondition not available: no source has false-positive articles. All 12 sources show only FAILING ARTICLES tab. Re-enable on a dashboard with mixed classification sources.

steps.title: Given a completed analysis where a source has both failing articles and false-positive articles
When the explanation panel is opened and the Failing articles tab is reviewed
Then the false-positive articles are absent from the Failing articles tab count

results.notes: Dataset does not contain sources with false-positive articles. All sources show only failing articles.

results.title: TC-GEO-1117-005 - Failing article passage max 140 chars

steps.title: Given a completed analysis with at least one source having a failing article where the brand is named negatively
When the explanation panel is opened and the failing article with a negative mention is visible
Then the extracted passage is shown verbatim with the brand name highlighted
And the passage does not exceed 140 characters including spaces

results.notes: 8 passages in ev-intelligence.com: 7 x 140 chars content (142 with typographic quotes), 1 x 88 chars. All at or below 140. Brand tesla highlighted via mark element bg-[#E0F2FE] in all 8 passages.

results.title: TC-GEO-1117-006 - Unfetchable article contributes nothing

steps.title: Given a completed analysis where at least one suspect article URL returned a fetch error
When the explanation panel is opened for the source whose article was unfetchable
Then the unfetchable article does not appear in the failing article count or in the panel

results.notes: PARTIAL - No source panel shows an unfetchable or fetch error marker. Cannot verify unfetchable exclusion behavior from UI alone. Dataset does not expose this edge case.

results.title: TC-GEO-1117-007 - Source with zero failing articles absent from list

steps.title: Given a completed analysis where a suspect source had all its articles verify as false positives
When the Target Sources list renders on the ALL tab
Then the source with zero failing articles is not present in any tab of the Target Sources

results.notes: PARTIAL - All 12 visible sources have at least 1 failing article (8, 2, 1x10). No source shows 0 failing articles in ANY tab. Cannot confirm a zero-failing source was evaluated and excluded - requires backend data.
